title: Synesthetic colors lack presence because their models are counterfactually poor

statements.text: Synesthetic concurrents are experienced as not really there because the generative models behind them predict little about how they would change under action.

sources.quote: Concurrents are experienced as lacking in perceptual presence because of counterfactually impoverished generative models of how hidden causes would modify sensory signals (and associated precisions) in response to actions.
